REPORT

Subject (in full) Ordure Contract in Chinese controlled territory.

Made by D. I. Sih Tse Liang Forwarded by W. Houncan D.S.I.

The ordure contractors of Chinese controlled
territory about one month ago submitted a demand to the
Bureau of Finance of the Shanghai City Government for
a reduction in the monthly contract fee by 20%.
Chinese controlled territory is divided into 3 areas for
the ordure contract, namely (I) the Central and West
Section (including City and the New Western District),
(II) South East Section (including Nantao Bund as far
(III)
as Zah Hwei Kong) and Chapei Section. The contract fee
by virtue of the existing contracts is (I) $4,200,
(II) $4,200 and (III) $4,000 respectively. The reason
forwarded by the present three contract holders is
trade depression, so much so that despite the price
of ordure being greatly reduced, the demands of the
agricultural districts, where it is generally believed
a depression prevails, have fallen off considerably.
In consequence of the demand of these contractors, two
of whom have failed to pay the contract fee for the last
two months, the Bureau of Finance inserted an advertisement
in local press of March 16 inviting tenders for the
(II) South East Section and (III) the Chapei District.
On March 26 the period for the tender expired and it
was discovered that there was one application submitted
for the Chapei District only and that this only application
was disqualified for the sum suggested being far below
the minimum. Consequently, on the expiration of the
present contract for the two sections in question by the
end of March 31, 1934, arrangement is being made by the
Bureau with the contractor of the Centre and Western

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处

编号 D 5765
第3巡捕房
日期 34/3/28）

事由（全称） 华界粪肥承包合同。

由督察长施子良（Sih Tse Liang）拟写，由副督察长 W. Houncan（音译）转呈。

约一个月前，华界的粪肥承包商向上海市政府财政局提出申请，要求将每月承包费降低20%。华界粪肥承包区域划分为三个区，即（一）中区及西区（包括老城厢及新西区），（二）东南区（包括南外滩直至 Zah Hwei Kong（音译）），以及（三）闸北区。根据现有合同，承包费分别为（一）4,200元，（二）4,200元，以及（三）4,000元。目前三位承包人提出的理由是市面萧条，尽管粪肥价格已大幅下调，但普遍认为同样处于萧条状态的农业地区的需求量已显著减少。鉴于这些承包商的要求，且其中两人已连续两个月未缴纳承包费，财政局于3月16日在本地报刊刊登广告，就（二）东南区及（三）闸北区进行招标。3月26日招标期届满，结果发现仅收到一份针对闸北区的投标申请，且因所报金额远低于最低限价而被取消资格。因此，鉴于上述两区的现行合同将于1934年3月31日期满，财政局正与中区及西区的承包商安排由其暂时垫资承办相关工作。据悉，鉴于局势日益恶化，该剩余承包商正考虑提出将费用降低40%的要求。

施子良
督察长
特别股主管
批
核
